summary: Create a weight loss landing page for Haridwar ayurveda, an ayurvedic products company.

existing_features.title: Create a single-page marketing landing page for the brand name “Haridwar ayurveda” focused on weight loss and ayurvedic products, with clear sections and calls-to-action.
Implement a lead capture form section (e.g., “Get a Consultation”) that collects name, email or phone, and a short message, with basic client-side validation and a success state.

Add a coherent, distinctive visual theme suitable for an ayurvedic wellness/weight-loss brand and apply it consistently across typography, spacing, buttons, and section styling (avoid blue/purple as primary colors).
Add generated brand visuals as static assets and integrate them into the landing page (logo in header/footer; hero illustration/banner in hero; optional product-style imagery in product highlights).
Add a new updated Haridwar Ayurveda logo image as a static asset under frontend/public/assets/generated, and keep the existing logo file intact.
Update the landing page branding to use the new logo asset everywhere the current logo is referenced (at minimum: Header and Footer).
